input.old_string: ## Changelog
input.new_string:
- 2026-08-10: v1.7.0 "can't update a budget" root-caused by reproduction matrix (test harness replaying the SPA's exact save flow). Three distinct defects: (a) completePrevious skipped already-completed versions whose windows still overlapped the new one, so amounts double-counted (typed $700, stored $764.52 — the killer after any mid-month change); (b) the wizard posted EVERY row, and the monthly↔period rounding round-trip versioned untouched non-monthly envelopes on every save; (c) a cleared From date sent effectiveFrom "" which zod 400ed the whole save. Fixes: window-overlap supersession in both completePrevious loops (budget + income), changed-rows-only posting, and truthy-guarded chronology fields. Fully-superseded versions become degenerate windows resolving to 0 — the template port is append/update-only by design, so no delete surface was added for cosmetics.
- 2026-08-10: Category dismissal is SERVER state (dismissed_categories table, POST /api/categories/dismiss, GET /api/categories/dismissed), replacing the ephemeral card-level useState that reset on reload. Per-category clear buttons added to the new-categories card (Nick: no per-category clear existed); the card-level X now clears all listed persistently. Settings → Connection gains a "Not synced" section listing cleared categories with Restore. Adopt modal gains a Start date (effectiveFrom) field, and the adopt handler anchors rolloverStart to it.
- 2026-08-10: refined: RootCauseAnalysis (5 Whys) confirmed the supersession root cause and flagged two deferred design points: (1) putTemplateLine validation rejecting inverted windows conflicts with the truncation approach and was skipped; (2) the wizard's default From (first of month) after a mid-month boundary means "make the whole month the typed amount", which matches user intent — surfacing existing boundaries in the edit UI is a possible future refinement.

input.old_string: ## Changelog
input.new_string:
- 2026-08-10: v1.8.0 (same-day follow-up from Nick's live usage). (1) Car Change Over reproduced the Relocation shape — adopt created the mapping from 2026-08-01 while transactions run back to 2024-06-24 — root fix: a category with ANY mapping is adopted/known and never re-lists as "new"; the adopt modal now warns when transactions predate the chosen start date (firstSeenDate added to aggregates) instead of silently leaving history unbudgeted. Car Change Over mapping left at 2026-08-01 pending Nick's call (back-dating would pull two years of spend into the envelope). (2) Dismissal is activity-aware per Nick's request: dismissing snapshots the category's newest transaction date; anything newer re-shows it on the budget page and drops it from Not synced until re-dismissed. Snapshot chosen over a wall-clock cutoff because future-dated (scheduled/pending) transactions could never be suppressed by a clock rule — caught by the reproduction test failing. Legacy rows (21 pre-snapshot dismissals) fall back to the dismissed-day rule. (3) Nick's "how do I set an end date" exposed a real no-op: editBudget skipped any line whose amount was unchanged, so an end-date-only edit did nothing. An explicit effectiveTo now always applies (expense + income paths). The Add/Edit modal's To field therefore works; its From default (first of current month) is the change-effective date, not the budget's start. Same ""-guard applied to that modal's cleared dates.
